_comment: Generic fallback currency/ubiquitous metabolite list (BioCyc frame ids, compartment suffix stripped, case-insensitive) used to de-emphasize near-universal cofactors in the reaction substrate/product UI. This is NOT organism-specific curation -- fasttarget/ftscripts/pathways.py:ubiquitous_checker expects a real curated file per organism; when one is available, prefer it. This bundled list is the safe default when no curated file is supplied.
